title: Solar particle event — take shelter
what: A solar particle event is in progress. Radiation levels outside shielded areas are elevated.
whySpace: Outside Earth's magnetosphere, solar energetic particles can deliver a large dose in hours. Shielding is the main protection.
doNow: Move to the designated storm shelter area now
Stay until the event-end notice
Log time spent outside shelter

title: Projected mission dose above career limit
what: At the current dose rate, total mission dose is projected to exceed the career exposure limit.
whySpace: Cumulative radiation dose raises long-term cancer risk; long missions beyond LEO accumulate dose quickly.
doNow: Minimise time in low-shielding areas
Review the dose log with the crew medical officer
Flag the projection in the next ground report

title: Elevated heart rate / blood pressure
what: Resting heart rate or blood pressure is above your personal baseline.
whySpace: Fluid shifts, stress, poor sleep and deconditioning in microgravity can change cardiovascular readings.
doNow: Rest seated for 10 minutes, then re-measure
Hydrate and avoid caffeine for the next few hours
Log any symptoms (dizziness, chest discomfort, palpitations)

title: Low heart rate variability
what: Heart rate variability is below your personal baseline, a common marker of stress or incomplete recovery.
whySpace: Workload, isolation and disturbed sleep in flight can reduce recovery capacity.
doNow: Do a 5-minute paced-breathing session
Prioritise sleep tonight
Re-measure tomorrow morning before activity

title: Sleep deficit / low mood
what: Sleep duration or mood check-in is below your personal baseline.
whySpace: Light-dark cycles, noise and schedule shifts disrupt sleep in space; sleep loss affects mood and performance.
doNow: Protect an 8-hour sleep window tonight (lights, noise, schedule)
Avoid screens 1 hour before sleep
Talk with a crewmate or schedule a private conference

title: Exercise below target
what: Daily exercise time is below your personal baseline.
whySpace: Without regular loading, bone and muscle are lost quickly in microgravity.
doNow: Schedule the missed resistance session today
Add a short cardio block to the next exercise slot
Log the reason for missed exercise

title: Change in near vision
what: Your near-vision self-check score is below your personal baseline.
whySpace: Spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS) can change vision during long missions.
doNow: Repeat the self-check in good lighting
Note any headaches or visual changes
Request an onboard eye exam if the change persists
